cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
p=open('submission/main.py').read()
old='''        cap = 0
        for n in range(m):
            cap += left[n]
        acc = 0
'''
new='''        cap = 0
        for n in range(m):
            cap += left[n]
        if cap < suff_cnt[i]:
            acc = 0
'''
assert old in p
body_start=p.index(new)+len(new)
# find end of the 1D block and indent it by 4
end=p.index("        cand = val + acc\n", body_start)+len("        cand = val + acc\n        if cand < best[0] or (cand == best[0] and cnt >= best[1]):\n            return\n")
block=p[p.index("        cap = 0\n"):end]
inner=block.split("        if cap < suff_cnt[i]:\n")[1]
inner="".join(("    "+l if l.strip() else l) for l in inner.splitlines(True))
newblock="        if cap < suff_cnt[i]:\n"+inner
p=p.replace(block,newblock)
open('submission/main.py','w').write(p)
EOF
